tools.name: G_NEQ joint-signature calibration
tools.abstraction: After source-justified normalization of the G_NEQ canonical covering pairs to common partitions, encode each diagonal witness by its membership signature; covering all canonical unequal-pair filters is equivalent to injectivity of these signatures.
preconditions: target is the G_NEQ canonical semi-filter calibration from Cavalar-Oliveira Proposition 40
Claim 41 applies to the singleton complement fibres
Lemmas 42-43 justify replacing each relevant pair by a partition without losing canonical coverage
structural_signature: one common integral family of binary partitions
tools.operation: map each diagonal witness to its joint membership signature under the normalized pair family; require injectivity and use N<=2^k as the exact canonical calibration floor
guaranteed_effects: detects whether a proposed joint-consistency repair recovers the exact log2 N canonical G_NEQ benchmark
distinguishes C024-style independence failure from a later representation-scope failure
non_guarantees: does not normalize arbitrary full semi-filters
does not bound every mathematical function of a signature matrix
does not produce a super-log full-cover lower bound
does not establish novelty or P versus NP
validation_obligations: bind every normalization step to Claim 41/Lemmas 42-43 and the G_NEQ canonical family
verify the induced signatures are injective exactly when all canonical F_(u,v) are covered
after passing calibration, check whether the retained state has any noncanonical full-semi-filter content before target evaluation

tools.name: Fractional semi-filter packing certificate
tools.abstraction: Use the LP dual of the Cavalar-Oliveira cover graph: weight semi-filters so every pair/fusion covers at most unit total weight; total weight lower-bounds cover and cyclic intersection complexity.
preconditions: the exact Cavalar-Oliveira cover graph is the target lower-bound object
the proposed semi-filter weights are nonnegative and satisfy unit mass under every pair neighbourhood
structural_signature: set-cover formulation of fusion lower bound
cyclic intersection complexity equals integral cover complexity
tools.operation: construct or verify a dual-feasible semi-filter weighting y; return sum(y) as a certified lower bound on cover/cyclic intersection complexity
guaranteed_effects: every verified dual-feasible weighting yields a rigorous lower bound on rho(A,B) and D_cyclic_intersection(A|B)
non_guarantees: plain fractional packing need not approximate integral cover within a constant factor
does not recover correlation among multiple integral pair choices
does not provide an explicit super-logarithmic target
does not establish novelty or P versus NP
validation_obligations: verify every semi-filter weight is nonnegative
prove for every pair p that the y-mass of semi-filters covered by p is at most 1
calibrate against G_NEQ and other known integral-gap examples before route promotion
evidence_pointers: Karchmer-Kushilevitz-Nisan Fractional Covers and Communication Complexity

tools.name: Upper-bound-first target screening
tools.abstraction: Before investing in a lower-bound invariant or hard target, derive the strongest explicit construction/adjacency implementation available and use it as a ceiling on the target complexity.
preconditions: target family is explicit enough to admit a concrete cover/intersection or adjacency construction
the upper construction is stated in the same unrestricted cover/intersection model as the intended lower bound
structural_signature: cheap adjacency or decomposition may dominate apparent combinatorial hardness
upper construction can falsify an entire lower-bound target family
tools.operation: derive an explicit cover/intersection program or compile the adjacency predicate before lower-bound search; reject the target if the resulting ceiling contradicts the desired asymptotic lower bound
guaranteed_effects: within the proved construction scope, supplies an auditable upper ceiling that any lower-bound candidate must respect
can retire target families whose explicit implementation is already too cheap
non_guarantees: does not prove any lower bound
does not show that every explicit family is easy
does not establish P versus NP
validation_obligations: verify that the construction uses legal operations in the exact target model
check asymptotic translation between input bit length and side size
